summary: Strict tightening of the write boundary: the approved-plan write allowance is gone, .factory/ hand-edits are denied (evidence-by-recorder strengthened), the repo-kind marker stays untouchable in every window including degraded, the window pins repo-kind at open so mid-window marker deletion cannot reclassify machinery, and the guard admits read-only by parsed argument content with unknown flags denied and env-var name laundering caught. Evasion shapes are pinned by test in both directions including split-token and quoted-metachar attempts. The degraded window is the sole write permit: bounded (5 files), reasoned, ledgered, PR-declared.
residual_risks: Hook enforcement binds tool calls, not intent: content can be authored in exempt paths and delegated for placement - by design, since the delegated worker is the reviewed write path.
Client repos: vendored machinery is exempt from the session lockout there because vendor-integrity freezing is the governing gate for those paths; the two gates are complementary, not redundant.
